title: classifier operation
description: A size classifier defined by its partition curve alone, on the case's size grid (`sizeGrid {}` in system/flowsheetDict; King 2001 section 4.2, Herbst & Fuerstenau 1980 p. 18): coarse_k = a_k f_k m_s, fine_k = f_k m_s - coarse_k class by class, so the products close on the feed exactly. One solid population; no work, no heat. Outputs (coarse fine).

partition.title: Partition curve (corrected)
partition.description: The corrected classification function c(d): the fraction of a size class that reports to the coarse product, before the bypass. whiten: c = 1 - (e^a - 1)/(e^(a d/d50c) + e^a - 2) (Nageswararao et al. 2004 eq. 21). rosinRammler: c = 1 - exp(-0.693 (d/d50)^m) (King 2001 eq. 4.41). tabulated: c_k declared class by class on the case's own grid, pan first.

d50.title: Cut size (rosinRammler)
d50.description: c(d50) = 0.49993 (King's constant 0.693 is kept as printed).

m.title: Sharpness m (rosinRammler)
m.description: King uses 5.9 for a vibrating screen.

corrected.title: Class values (tabulated)
corrected.description: Exactly one value per class of the case's size grid, the pan first, each in [0, 1].

bypass.title: Bypass R
bypass.description: The fraction of EVERY class short-circuited to the coarse product: the actual partition is a_k = R + (1 - R) c_k.

fluidToCoarse.title: Fluid to the coarse product
fluidToCoarse.description: Only when the feed carries a fluid: the fraction of it leaving with the coarse product (the case's declaration, never a default).
